notes.title: Release Date Announced, BackerKit Surveys, and More!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We’re extremely excited to announce that We should talk will release on Steam, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch on Thursday, July 16th 2020, with the Playstation 4 release to be announced shortly after! We’re super happy to announce this, and can’t wait for you to be able to play We should talk in just a few weeks.

BackerKit Surveys and Merch

In addition, thanks to the success of our Kickstarter campaign, we’re able to sell official We should talk merch for a limited time! From now until July 2nd, you’ll be able to purchase an official We should talk T-shirt, pin, and sticker sheet, all seen below.

You’ll also be able to purchase a steam key for when the game launches, as well as a “Games are for Everyone” and “ I Love Easy Games” pin from our publisher, Whitethorn Games. All of this can be found here on our limited-time-only Preorder Store!  


Watch now: "The Design of We should talk: Putting a New Spin on Player Choice"

Last Wednesday, we premiered our We should talk seminar from Carol and Jordan that you unlocked by helping us reach our 450 backer stretch goal! You can find the archive of the stream followed by extended Q&A below
[previewyoutube=FRtqb6NulR8;full][/previewyoutube]

Alpha-to-Release Retrospective Live Stream on July 10th

Our FINAL community livestream will be a retrospective of the games development from the team, showing its journey from alpha to release, and that will be live on twitch.tv/insatiablecycle on July 10th! Stay tuned for more info on that!

Thank You!
-The We should talk team

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
It’s been a long road, but we’ve finally launched our Steam page! Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game and played our demo. Your support means so much to us!

This week, We should talk is taking part in the spring Steam Game Festival as part of the MEGABOOTH lineup. It’s been fantastic seeing the positive reception to our demo, which will be available for a limited time. Please check it out if you haven't already!

We should talk will be launching June 2020 
Coming to PC, Mac, and all major consoles! We can't wait to share the full game with all of you this summer!

To stay up to date on announcements, please follow us on Twitter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37062163/1a60ddf6fac0e7bbd6b23780387013d212b41ee0.gif

More about the game:
We should talk explores the nuance of words and conversation. How does what we say, and how we say it, change how people respond to us? How does our relationship with another person affect how we express ourselves to them? 

Using a unique dialogue choice mechanic, players assemble sentences from modular fragments to craft responses. Through texts with their partner and in person conversations with fellow patrons at a local bar, our protagonist will determine whether their romantic relationship survives the night.

 Have personal, intimate conversations with 4 unique characters
 Your choices unlock many different conversational paths
 Play again and again: find all 9 possible endings
